title: VTU YOUTH FESTIVAL PRATHIBHOTSAVA – 2022
content:
21st VTU YOUTH FESTIVAL, “PRATHIBHOTSAVA – 2022” was organized by BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru various Cultural and literary event was Scheduled from 29th – 31st July 2022. Based on the screening done at college 10 events were shortlisted and 14 students were selected as participants for the event. Two male faculty managers were accompanied for the event along with students. Students along with faculties reached BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru campus on 29th of July morning, followed by registration and settled back at accommodation provided by organizing committee.
